FAQ.Title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.Subtitle: Quick answers to keep growing together.

Item1.Question: Can I write anonymously?
Item1.Answer: Yes. Mention it in your message; we will handle your request without revealing your identity to other members.

Item2.Question: Who reads sensitive messages?
Item2.Answer: Only the Wake Up & Spark lead team, committed to confidentiality and care.

Item3.Question: How can I propose a workshop or partnership?
Item3.Answer: Choose “Partnership / sponsor” or “Event / workshop” in the subject, describe your idea, and share your availability.
